NORTE FIRE EXPLODES TO 465 ACRES, DESTROYS HOMES IN SOUTH OC

The Norte Fire is burning homes in San Clemente and San Juan Capistrano and is still not contained.

The fire has grown to 465 acres and is 0% contained as of 2:40 p.m., according to Cal Fire. At least four homes have been destroyed. Flames tore through neighborhoods along Avenida Calita, Via La Mirada and Via De Agua in San Juan Capistrano.

EVACUATION ORDERS (LEAVE NOW):
📍 San Juan Capistrano Zones 4, 5, 10
📍 San Clemente Zones 12, 13

SHELTERS:
San Juan Capistrano Community Center, 25925 Camino del Avion
San Clemente Community Center, 100 N. Calle Seville

The fire started around 11:30 a.m. near Portico Del Norte and grew from 50 acres to more than 450 in about three hours, driven by Santa Ana winds. Helicopters, air tankers and ground crews are working the fire. No injuries have been reported, and the cause is under investigation.

Check your zone at https://t.co/Q793ulNXfT.

#NorteFire #SanClemente #SanJuanCapistrano #OrangeCounty #Wildfire

answers.note: One search from 2026-10-16T00:00Z (relevancy) plus the #NorteFire trend-name stream. No post from the City of San Clemente or San Juan Capistrano was returned, and no OCFA post giving acres, containment, homes lost or cause. Kept: OCFA on evacuation shelters (2111199331437207758; its evacuation-zone post 2111182130411971037 is already on the re-read list), and California Courier (2111217414297784660), which says, citing Cal Fire, 465 acres and 0% contained as of 2:40 p.m., at least four homes destroyed, no injuries and the cause under investigation; it names the streets where homes burned but no residents. Many repeated aggregator posts gave 250 or 465 acres and "at least 10 homes" without a named source and were left out. A KTLA post on firefighters protecting another home (2111223736066331035) was left out because its on-screen caption names a nearby resident.
